items.title: Joey Morant interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: leave the ego at the door, like Quincy Jones said

ctx.x: Okay. You said that this morning. You said it’s about songs, and it makes me think that you heard that song and it had that impression on you right back then, because it’s about songs.

I think we’re all psychic to a degree. You are, your wife is, everybody is a psychic. They just haven’t tapped it yet. You have to be a psychic to have a brain. The way the brain vibrates, the way it generates protoplasm, the way it generates juice, dendrites, you know, we’re all psychic, we just haven’t tapped it. When I was a little boy, because of my father, I could read people. Minds. I could read places, things. I can just about tell you when something’s going to happen. Now how? How do I know that? Nobody…
Well that’s what they do here at Hamilton. That’s funny you say that because that’s almost like one of their slogans.
